info.name: Get an Organization by its number

params.name: organizationNumber
params.description: The organization's number (must be URL encoded)

items.docs: Retrieve a single organization by its unique organization number. The number must be URL encoded.

info.name: Update an Organization by its number

params.name: organizationNumber
params.description: The organization's number (must be URL encoded)

items.docs: Update an existing organization identified by its unique organization number. The number must be URL encoded. Supports partial updates — only the provided fields will be modified.

info.name: Delete an Organization by its number

params.name: organizationNumber
params.description: The organization's number (must be URL encoded)

items.docs: Deletes a single organization identified by its organization number. The number must be URL-encoded. Returns 204 on success or if the organization does not exist. Fails with 409 if multiple organizations share the same number.

info.name: Get a specific organization by ID

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the organization to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieve a single organization by its unique identifier.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the organization to update

items.docs: Update an existing organization identified by its unique ID. Supports partial updates — only the provided fields will be modified.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the organization to delete

items.docs: Permanently deletes a single organization identified by its unique ID. Returns 204 on success.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Define the sort order of the received payload. (asc/desc)

params.name: sortField
params.description: Specify the field used for sorting.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Define how many items will be received in the payload per request.(default 20 items, max 1000 items)

params.name: search
params.description: Allows to filter by the search phrase over name, organizationNumber, website, phoneNumber properties.

params.name: createdAtFrom
params.description: Filter by createdAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

params.name: createdAtUntil
params.description: Filter by createdAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

params.name: updatedAtFrom
params.description: Filter by updatedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

params.name: updatedAtUntil
params.description: Filter by updatedAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of organizations. Supports filtering by creation and update timestamps, full-text search, and sorting.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Define how many items will be received in the payload per request.(default 20 items, max 1000 items)
